svg.title: API Gateway
svg.desc: API Gateway. One entry point that authenticates, rate-limits and routes calls to backend services. Step 1, One front door: Clients call one endpoint; each request is authenticated, rate-limited and routed by path. Step 2, Authenticate at the edge: No valid token: 401 at the edge and no service is called. A valid call goes on with its identity. Step 3, Rate limit per client: Partner bursts: its token bucket empties and the excess gets 429. Web is unaffected; tokens refill. Step 4, Serve from cache: A repeated GET /catalog is answered from the gateway's cache, so the Catalog service isn't called.

g.text: Clients call one endpoint; each request is authenticated, rate-limited and routed by path.
No valid token: 401 at the edge and no service is called. A valid call goes on with its identity.
Partner bursts: its token bucket empties and the excess gets 429. Web is unaffected; tokens refill.
A repeated GET /catalog is answered from the gateway's cache, so the Catalog service isn't called.

text.class: tiny mid sb f-amber-ink ag-w ag-burst

g.text: Also offloaded here: TLS termination · request/response transforms · logging and metrics
